item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang drag po'i rgyud dbang drag nor sgrub nyi zla'i kha sbyor
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas rab brtan lcags mo phag lo'i zla tshes nyin par/ sbas pa'i rong bzhi shar phyogs gnas chen ri'i byang phyogs seng ge brag ces nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi g.yon phyogs/ seng gdong phug nas rigs mthun gyi mkha' 'gros grogs mdzad cing khrom gter du spyan drangs par bgyis shing / slar yang zla tshes la bsod nams stobs kyi dbang po sa bdag rgyal po'i pho brang drug zur rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbus rtse nas/ mkha' 'gro'i brda yig shog ser bod yig tu phabs grub pa'o//
